# Mahoney Digital

> Websites, practical AI tools, and care plans for local businesses in Chillicothe, Ross County, and southern Ohio.

Mahoney Digital builds clean, fast websites for contractors, trades, and local shops. We also offer practical AI add-ons that recover missed leads, handle after-hours questions, and keep follow-up consistent — without hype or bloated retainers.

## Services

- Mobile-first website design and development (Essential, Growth, Signature packages starting at $1,450)
